skill.description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki and generate a knowledge graph with entities and topic clusters.

memory.responsibility: Retain markdown knowledge base plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform entity extractor into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through explicit and implicit links while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose source discovery and evidence-processing capabilities that preserve provenance and uncertainty.

stages: Index notes headings links and citations
Extract people concepts artifacts and claims
Connect explicit backlinks and inferred relations

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
